## Common JOIN Patterns

### 三级级联 JOIN：feature_toggle_info -> tag_mapping -> shop_tag_mapping

该表始终作为桥接表使用，位于 feature_toggle_info_tab 和 shop_tag_mapping_tab 之间：

```sql
-- 标准三级 JOIN 模式（出现于 11/11 文件）
SELECT feature_id
FROM marketplace.shopee_seller_feature_toggle_db__feature_toggle_info_tab__${region}_df a
INNER JOIN marketplace.shopee_seller_feature_toggle_db__feature_toggle_tag_mapping_tab__${region}_df b
    ON a.feature_id = b.feature_id
INNER JOIN marketplace.shopee_seller_shop_tag_mapping_${region}_db__shop_tag_mapping_tab__reg_continuous_s0_live c
    ON b.tag_id = c.tag_id
```

## Representative SQL Snippets

### 1. Auto-Rebate 白名单构建（query1，发现广告）
```sql
-- 通过 tag_mapping 找到白名单 shop_id
SELECT c.shop_id, feature_mode
FROM (
    SELECT feature_id, feature_mode
    FROM marketplace.shopee_seller_feature_toggle_db__feature_toggle_info_tab__${region}_df
    WHERE feature_key IN ('product_ads_gms_auto_rebate')
      AND feature_status = 1 AND feature_mode IN (2,4,5)
) a
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT tag_id, feature_id, ctime
    FROM marketplace.shopee_seller_feature_toggle_db__feature_toggle_tag_mapping_tab__${region}_df
    WHERE feature_toggle_tag_mapping_status != 3
) b ON a.feature_id = b.feature_id
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT shop_id, tag_id
    FROM marketplace.shopee_seller_shop_tag_mapping_${region}_db__shop_tag_mapping_tab__reg_continuous_s0_live
    WHERE region = UPPER('${region}') AND shop_tag_mapping_status = 1
    GROUP BY shop_id, tag_id
) c ON b.tag_id = c.tag_id
```

### 2. ROI2/MPD ROAS 保护白名单构建（workflow，10个地域）
```sql
-- 每个地域一个文件，结构完全相同
SELECT
    shop_id,
    date(date_format(from_utc_timestamp(to_utc_timestamp(
        cast(ctime as timestamp),'Asia/Singapore'), '${timezone}'),
        'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss')) as whitelist_date
FROM (
    SELECT feature_id
    FROM marketplace.shopee_seller_feature_toggle_db__feature_toggle_info_tab__${region}_df
    WHERE feature_key IN ('product_ads_gms_mpd_roas_protection')
      AND feature_status = 1
) a
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT tag_id, feature_id, ctime
    FROM marketplace.shopee_seller_feature_toggle_db__feature_toggle_tag_mapping_tab__${region}_df
    WHERE feature_toggle_tag_mapping_status != 3
) b ON a.feature_id = b.feature_id
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT shop_id, tag_id
    FROM marketplace.shopee_seller_shop_tag_mapping_${region}_db__shop_tag_mapping_tab__reg_continuous_s0_live
    WHERE region = UPPER('${region}') AND shop_tag_mapping_status = 1
    GROUP BY shop_id, tag_id
) c ON b.tag_id = c.tag_id
```
